reason: I'm away at my other work half the week, and the live chair view, cancelled-bill check and drawer-cash figure are exactly what I worry about. At ₹10,000 plus ₹500 a month, one leak caught pays for it, so I'd try it, as long as I can set up the attendance part my way.
objection: My senior stylists have been with me for years. If they have to check in on their own phones and see me watching every bill, they'll feel I don't trust them, and in a 15-person team that can cost me good people. Putting it on their personal phones and having it only in English also worries me.
would_change_my_mind: If the attendance check-in can't be switched off or made soft, or if a couple of my senior staff push back hard at the training, I'd walk away.
